info.name: Crestron XIO Cloud API
info.description:
Crestron XiO Cloud Public API collection based on the official SDK reference at [https://sdkcon78221.crestron.com/sdk/Crestron_XiO_Cloud_SDK/Content/Topics/API-Reference.htm](https://sdkcon78221.crestron.com/sdk/Crestron_XiO_Cloud_SDK/Content/Topics/API-Reference.htm)

**Authentication:** All requests require the `XiO-subscription-key` header (set at collection level using the `{{subscriptionKey}}` variable). Public API access must be enabled by Crestron Support.

**Rate Limits:**

- V1 endpoints: 1 request per 5 minutes
    
- V2 endpoints: 3 requests per minute
    

**Variables needed from a local vault:** `accountId`, `subscriptionKey`

Variables needed from an Environment: `pagenum`, pagesize, `deviceModel`, `groupId`, groupIdSub, `deviceCid`, `deviceCid2`, macAddress, `serialNumber`.

Get Notifications Informations will store the Websocket uri in the variable `ws_address.` Then the Crestron XIO `Cloud Websocket` Collection can use that variable to start a web socket connection and listen to XIO cloud reports

request.description: This method returns account details. Rate limit: 1 request per 5 minutes (V1).

This method returns all devices for the account.

request.description:
This method returns all of the device status fields for up to 20 devices.

A DeviceIds request parameter must be issued that contains an array of unique device CIDs as shown in the following example body request.

**NOTE**: If the request contains more than 20 device CIDs, the request will be rejected with a 400 status code ("Request device limit exceeded, maximum 20 devices can support!"). If no body is provided with the request, the request will be rejected with a 400 status code ("Request devices are empty"). If the request contains any incorrect CIDs, these will be skipped and reported in the MissingDevices response parameter.

### Variables

`accountId`: **Required**. String that sets the customer account ID that is issued after enabling public API access.

request.description:
This method returns the device status for all devices within a particular account. A user can specify the number of devices and the page number to query. The maximum number of devices which can be queried is restricted to 20 devices.

### Variables

`accountId`: **Required**. String that sets the customer account ID that is issued after enabling public API access.

`pagenum`: **Required**. A numeric value that sets the page number that should be queried.

`pagesize`: **Required**. A numeric value that sets the page size (number of devices) that should be returned

request.description:
This method returns the device status for all devices of a specific model within a particular account. A user can specify the number of devices and the page number to query. The maximum number of devices which can be queried is restricted to 20 devices.

**NOTE**: The device model can be obtained via the "device-model" property in the device query response.

### Variables

`accountId`: **Required**. String that sets the customer account ID that is issued after enabling public API access.

`deviceModel`: **Required**. String that sets the device model that should be queried.

`pagenum`: **Required**. A numeric value that sets the page number that should be queried.

`pagesize`: **Required**. A numeric value that sets the page size (number of devices) that should be returned

If the request contains any incorrect CIDs, these will be skipped and reported in the MissingDevices response parameter.
